entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. [He] sits [between] the cherubs; let the earth quake.

entries.title: Psalms 99:2
segments: The LORD [is] great in Zion; and He [is] high above all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments: Let them praise Your great and fearful name; it [is] holy.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: The king's strength also loved judgment; You established uprightness; You worked judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He [is] holy.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: Moses and Aaron [were] among His priests, and Samuel among those who called on His name; they called on the LORD, and He answered them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; they kept His testimonies and the ordinance [that] He gave them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: You answered them, O LORD our God; You were a God who forgave them, though You take vengeance for their deeds.

entries.title: Psalms 99:9
segments: Praise the LORD our God, and worship at His holy hill; for the LORD our God [is] holy.
